description: This PHP class 'EmailQueueDao' provides data access methods for email queue management within the OrangeHRM system. It includes functions to get, save, delete, and list pending emails from the database.

classes.name: EmailQueueDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for managing email queue entities in the database.

methods.name: getEmail
methods.description: Retrieves a Mail entity by its ID.

methods.name: saveEmail
methods.description: Saves a Mail entity to the database.

methods.name: removeFromQueue
methods.description: Removes multiple Mail entities from the queue based on their IDs.

methods.name: getAllPendingMailIds
methods.description: Returns an array of IDs for all pending Mail entities.
